name: Mem
summary: Store and retrieve memories (notes, facts, decisions, snippets, images) using a local SQLite database with full-text search. Use when you need to remember information across sessions, recall previous decisions, store code snippets, or search your knowledge base.

name: Mini Browser
summary: Browser automation skill for AI agents using the mb CLI. Use when the agent needs to browse the web, take screenshots, scrape text, fill forms, click elements, record screencasts, run JS in pages, or audit designs. Triggers on: "browse", "open a page", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "fill form", "click button", "web automation", "record screen", "design audit", "accessibility check".
